metadata.description: Hawaii Fishing Areas and Zones — commercial longline, nearshore, exclusion zones
metadata.note: Reference only. Verify boundaries with NOAA NMFS before fishing. Regulations subject to change.
metadata.source: NOAA NMFS Pacific Islands Regional Office + WCPFC + Hawaii DAR

properties.name: Hawaii Longline Fishing Area
properties.description: Hawaii-based longline fleet operating area. Pelagic species: swordfish, bigeye tuna, yellowfin tuna.
properties.target_species: Swordfish, Bigeye tuna, Yellowfin tuna, Mahi-mahi, Wahoo

properties.name: Turtle Exclusion Zone — Longline (Shallow-Set)
properties.description: Area where shallow-set longline is managed to minimize loggerhead and leatherback turtle interactions. NOAA NMFS regulated.
properties.regulation: 50 CFR Part 665 — Hawaii Pelagic Longline Fishery

properties.name: Coral Reef Ecosystem MPA — Northwestern Hawaiian Islands
properties.description: Papahānaumokuākea Marine National Monument. Largest protected area in US. Commercial fishing prohibited.

properties.name: Hawaii Nearshore Fishing Zone (0–3nm)
properties.description: State waters: nearshore commercial and recreational fishing. Hook-and-line, net fishing, spearfishing. Managed by Hawaii DAR.

properties.name: Penguin Bank — Nearshore Productive Zone
properties.description: Shallow bank between Molokai and Oahu (depth 40-90m). Highly productive bottom fishing area — moi, onaga, opakapaka, hapu'u.
properties.target_species: Onaga (long-tail snapper), Opakapaka (pink snapper), Hapu'u (grouper), Moi

properties.name: Maui Nui Bottom Fishing Ground
properties.description: Inter-island waters between Maui, Molokai, Lanai, Kahoolawe. Productive deepwater snapper fishing 150-300m.

properties.name: Big Island Kona Coast — Pelagic Sport Fishing
properties.description: World-famous billfish grounds off Kona. Blue marlin, striped marlin, spearfish, mahi-mahi, ahi. Kona has hosted IGFA world records.
properties.target_species: Blue Marlin, Striped Marlin, Broadbill Swordfish, Mahi-mahi, Ahi (yellowfin)

properties.name: Kauai Channel — Pelagic Fishing Corridor
properties.description: Kaieiewaho Channel between Oahu and Kauai. Active corridor for mahi-mahi, ono, ahi, and shortbill spearfish.

properties.name: Hawaii EEZ Boundary (200nm)
properties.description: US Exclusive Economic Zone boundary — 200nm from Hawaii baselines. Beyond this = international waters (WCPFC regulation).

properties.name: Main Hawaiian Islands Small Boat Exclusion Zone (Longline)
properties.description: Longline fishing prohibited within 75nm of main Hawaiian Islands coastline (MHI prohibited area). Small-scale handline and trolling permitted.
